title: Coupled sagittal and lateral moments during axial rotation at 30-100% MVC, standing, males (normalised)

quantity.name: coupled moment
quantity.definition: mean coupled torque (stable 3 s) in sagittal and coronal planes during right/left axial rotation, normalised to the maximal torque of the subject in that plane/direction (from the 6 MVCs); sign: + flexion / + right lateral flexion
quantity.unit: % of MVC moment in that direction

source.authors: Ng JK-F, Parnianpour M, Richardson CA, Kippers V
source.sample: 23 subjects (23 M); healthy right-handed males without history of back pain

protocol.summary: Erect standing in a B200 Isostation triaxial dynamometer (mechanically locked in 3 planes), L5-S1 interspinous space aligned with the flexion/extension axis; pelvis and lower legs stabilised by pelvic restraint, thigh and knee straps; torso fixed by chest restraint and thoracic pad; arms folded across the chest above the chest restraint. MVCs (5 s, 2 min rest) in flexion, extension, right/left lateral flexion and right/left axial rotation with visual feedback; then submaximal right/left axial rotation at 70, 50, 30% MVC (visual target). Torques = mean over stable 3 s, baseline (relaxed standing in device) subtracted; moments measured about the dynamometer axes (flexion/extension axis at L5-S1 interspinous space).
how_to_simulate: Upright standing, pelvis fixed, thorax restrained (isometric)
Prescribe right/left axial rotation moment at 30, 50, 70, 100% of the model's axial MVC (or the measured 78 Nm)
Let the model solve muscle forces with free off-axis moments (or report the off-axis moments the muscles generate)
Compare coupled flexion/extension and lateral moments at L5-S1, each divided by the model's MVC in that direction
protocol.notes: Values are % not Nm (MVCs in flexion/extension/lateral flexion not reported). Coupled lateral bending is ipsilateral (right rotation -> right lateral flexion). Sagittal coupling is significantly different from zero (flexion) only at 100% MVC; lateral coupling significant at all levels.

extraction.uncertainty: ±2 % (sagittal panel, 1.44 px/%), ±3 % (lateral panel, 1.09 px/%; hollow markers)
extraction.check_notes: Digitised by pixel analysis of 200-dpi render (axis ticks located at 0/±50/100%); markers/caps located by row-width profiles; values checked visually against page image (e.g. left AR 100% lateral -41%, right AR 100% sagittal +14%). SD = one-sided error bar length.
